responsibility: This file implements GCC's OpenVMS linker wrapper, translating Unix/GNU-style linker arguments into a VMS LINK command plus option file. It searches libraries along -L paths with VMS-specific extension preferences, converts file specifications to host syntax, recognizes shareable images, object libraries, identification and GSMATCH directives, emits linker option records for DWARF and exception-handling sections, invokes the native linker, and post-processes the output image to set VMS executable flags such as nocall_debug, mkthreads, and upcalls.
